title: K2 Space header
description: A transparent fixed bar over the hero: a thin wide-set wordmark left, four quiet links across the middle and a live mission clock right that ticks every second (T+ days, hours, minutes, seconds / mission name). Phones get the wordmark and a two-line menu button that opens a black panel of large links. As soon as the page scrolls, the bar fades out and lifts away (scroll 80–180px).
notes: fixed to the window and overlaying the first section: put it before a window-tall hero
the fade-out is CSS scroll-driven (off under reduced motion, where the bar simply stays)
needs JavaScript for the clock and the phone menu
name: k2space-header
